advances:
The complete finite opposite residual of accepted fact `18e8f69f5a782c16` is nonempty after imposing both the corrected piecewise \(R_{jk}\)-fit condition of `06afbd5c9e94d1a2` and the \(R_{k\ell}\)-fit condition of `ed46def84052c5bf`.  The survivor below is in the strict branch \(A<\beta\), but retains the literal zero branch \(\gamma=\tau=0\), two endpoint-cap selector equalities, two trace equalities, and two coordinatewise-separator equalities.  Thus neither accepted chord test, separately or together with every currently accepted finite row, eliminates the opposite system.

For this survivor the next small positive-budget cell is \(R_N\), of budget \(z=1/10000\).  The next fixed endpoint data to test are the full \(A_0\) diagonal chord
\[
(\delta+t,-t),\qquad 0\le t\le K,
\]
and the full \(A_2\) chord
\[
V=0,\qquad u\le U\le u+H_2.
\]
Their midpoint parallelogram lies in \(R_N\) and has area \(KH_2/(4\Delta)=1/4000000<z\), so these two bare chords fit; any next \(R_N\) obstruction must enlarge this parallelogram using adjacent fixed chord endpoints.

proof:
First, (1) is an exhaustive literal split.  If \(A<\beta\), then
\(B-A=H+\beta-A>H\), so the minimum in the accepted criterion is
\(H/(B-A)\).  If \(A=\beta\), then \(B-A=H\), and the two accepted
formulas agree.  If \(\beta<A<B\), then \(0<B-A<H\), so the minimum
is \(1\).  The accepted \(A=B\) value is also \(AH/(8\Delta)\).

At (3)-(6),
\[
A<\beta<B,\qquad
\beta-A=\frac{499}{500},\qquad
B-A=\frac{999}{1000}.
\]
The cleared right-minus-left slack in the first row of (1) is
\[
8(B-A)y-AH^2=\frac{979}{200000000}>0,
\tag{7}
\]
equivalently
\[
y-\frac{AH^2}{8(B-A)}
=\frac{979}{1598400000}>0.
\]
The hypotheses used by the accepted \(R_{jk}\) triangle are literal:
\[
u=\tau+H=\frac1{1000},\qquad
S-u-B=\frac{1999}{1000}>0.
\]
For (2),
\[
\tau K+2K_2(\tau+G)=\frac1{500000},
\qquad
8w-\bigl(\tau K+2K_2(\tau+G)\bigr)
=\frac{15999999}{500000}>0.
\tag{8}
\]

We now audit every inherited finite row.  The three scalar identities
are exact:
\[
c-g_0-y=0,\qquad
a+e+x-d-s-w=0,
\]
\[
2b-5(g_0+y+d+s+w)-7(g+z)=0.
\tag{9}
\]
The totals and common crossing are
\[
M=\frac{2714110609}{200000000},\qquad
m=\frac{1020063}{1000000},
\]
\[
\kappa=\frac{8000113}{1000000},\qquad
t=\frac{502016201}{100000000}.
\tag{10}
\]
The \(j\)- and \(k\)-cap triples are both
\[
\left(
\frac1{100000000},
\frac{1020049}{1000000},
\frac{4000113}{1000000}
\right),
\]
and the \(\ell\)-cap triple is
\[
\left(
\frac{4801}{100000000},
\frac{510007}{500000},
\frac{40001}{10000}
\right).
\]
Each sums to \(t\).  The three left-tail slacks are
\[
\frac{1399}{100000000},\qquad
\frac{1399}{100000000},\qquad
\frac{99}{100000000}.
\tag{11}
\]
The proper-cap slacks \((M-u_i,m-v_i,\kappa-C_i)\) are
\[
\left(\frac{2714110607}{200000000},\frac7{500000},4\right),
\]
\[
\left(\frac{2714110607}{200000000},\frac7{500000},4\right),
\qquad
\left(\frac{2714101007}{200000000},\frac{49}{1000000},
\frac{4000013}{1000000}\right).
\tag{12}
\]
Also
\[
M-t=\frac{1710078207}{200000000}>0,\qquad
M-m=\frac{2510098009}{200000000}>0.
\tag{13}
\]
Thus positivity, all crossings, both tails, proper caps, finite
interior, \(M\ge m\), \(0<t<M\), and \(W=0\) hold.

Let \(\eta_j,\eta_k,\eta_\ell\) be the accepted trace radicals.  The
exact square differences proving
\[
\eta_j,\eta_k<\frac1{2500},\qquad
\eta_\ell<\frac{13}{500}
\]
are
\[
\frac{97211799}{4{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000},\qquad
\frac{97211799}{4{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000},\qquad
\frac{107906294999}{4{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000}.
\tag{14}
\]
The resulting lower-trace margins for \(J,K,H\) are
\[
\frac{31}{31250},\qquad
\frac{31}{31250},\qquad
\frac3{6250}.
\tag{15}
\]
Here
\[
K_2-J=0,\qquad J_2-K=\frac2{125},\qquad H_2-H=0,
\]
so the two equal-trace disjunctions use the strict margins in (15).
The remaining trace-product slacks are
\[
2g_0-J_2H_2=\frac{53}{1000000}>0,
\qquad
\frac c3-KH=\frac3{200000}>0.
\tag{16}
\]
Since \(3-2\sqrt2>1/6\) and
\[
2\eta_k\eta_\ell
<2\left(\frac1{2500}\right)\left(\frac{13}{500}\right)
=\frac{13}{625000},
\]
while
\[
g_0\delta^2=\frac7{20},\qquad
c(3-2\sqrt2)\delta^2>\frac2{25}.
\]
Thus both accepted common trace-product rows hold strictly.

In the inherited \(A_0\) row order
\((10a),(10b),(11a),(11b),(11c),(12a),(12b)\), the exact
right-minus-left slacks are
\[
\frac{98001}{1000000},\quad 0,\quad

\]
The two positive-part selectors are

\]
Thus the \(\gamma=\tau=0\) perspective and completion equalities are

Counting the two sides of the \(A_2\) perspective row separately and

\]
Their two positive-part selectors are

\]

For every endpoint-cap row put
\[
\Theta=2Dr-L^2\sigma,\qquad
{\cal E}=D\sigma(r+L)^2-C(\Theta)_+.
\]
In the six inherited \(A_0\) rows, the exact pairs

\]
and the six \(A_2\) pairs are
\[

4&9896803/1000000000&50{,}459{,}229{,}447{,}795{,}049/1{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000\\
5&199053/100000000&217541531794311/500000000000000\\

Rows 3 and 4 of (21) lie exactly on the accepted

All boxes and literal incidences follow from (4)-(6):
\[
\alpha,\beta>0,\quad \gamma=\tau=0,\quad
u,v,\theta,w_0,\chi,\psi>0.
\]
The six coordinatewise-separator slacks are
\[

\]
Thus \(w_0=A\) and \(u=\tau+H\) are retained as equalities.  The three

\[

\]

For the global \(A_2\) slope row,
\[

\]
so this is branch (A+).  Its exact data are
\[

\]
\[

\]
\[

\]
The right-minus-left slack in (A+) is
\[

\]

The four endpoint-triangle slacks, in the inherited order, are
\[

\frac{199457179799}{20000000000},\qquad

\tag{26}
\]
The first is the literal \(\gamma=\tau=0\) tautology.  The applicable

\]
For the \(c\)-lens,

\]
This is the \(C\)-axis branch, with polynomial slack

The three scalar dominance-shadow slacks are

For the sharp dominance cap, the literal branch is

Finally, the proposed next \(R_N\) test is literal at this point.  On

\qquad

For their midpoint,

The last inequality is strict off one boundary segment.  Hence the

the stated next cell and why the two bare chords alone do not yet
eliminate the survivor.
statement:
On the registered domain \(A\le B=\beta+H\), the corrected fit condition has the literal four-branch form
\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
A<\beta&AH^2\le8\Delta(B-A)y\\
A=\beta&AH\le8\Delta y\\
\beta<A<B&AH\le8\Delta y\\
A=B&AH\le8\Delta y .
\end{array}
\tag{1}
\]
There is an exact rational point satisfying the complete finite system of accepted fact `18e8f69f5a782c16`, (1) from accepted fact `06afbd5c9e94d1a2`, and
\[
\tau K+2K_2(\tau+G)\le8\Delta w
\tag{2}
\]
from accepted fact `ed46def84052c5bf`.

Take
\[
\Delta=1,\qquad \delta=100,
\]
\[
\begin{array}{c|cccc}
P&a&b&c&d\\ \hline
&1/100000000&542820201/40000000&3/62500&1/100000000
\end{array},
\]
\[
\begin{array}{c|cccc}
Q&e&g_0&g&s\\ \hline
&7/500000&7/200000&51/50&7/500000
\end{array},
\qquad
\begin{array}{c|cccc}
R&x&y&z&w\\ \hline
&4&13/1000000&1/10000&4 .
\end{array}
\tag{3}
\]
For \(A_0\), take
\[
J=H=K=\frac1{1000},\qquad
\alpha=99,\qquad
\beta=\frac{99999}{1000},\qquad
\gamma=\tau=0.
\tag{4}
\]
For \(A_2\), take
\[

J_2=\frac{17}{1000},\qquad
v=\frac{17}{500},\qquad
w_0=\frac{99001}{1000}.
\tag{5}
\]
The derived values are
\[
A=\frac{99001}{1000},\quad
B=100,\quad G=\frac1{1000},\quad S=102,
\]
\[
\chi=\frac{999}{1000},\quad
\omega=100,\quad
\theta=\frac{50999}{500},\quad
\psi=\frac{1499}{500}.
\tag{6}
\]
No polygon realization is asserted.
